extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in Middle East politics, social movements, secularism, and human rights
extracted.subtask_short: analysis of Arab atheism and politics
extracted.subtask_description: Long-form news/essay analyzing the rise of atheism, secularist and leftist movements, anarchism, feminism, and religious conservatism in Arab countries, including case examples (Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Tunisia) and commentary on public reactions (e.g., social media, prosecutions, Charlie Hebdo).
